name: GJ 631
description: A nearby orange dwarf, 76% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 631: radius in solar radii, 0.7591 +/- 0.0122, from this work (CHARA)

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 631: mass 0.821 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 631: effective temperature in K, 5337 +/- 41, from this work (CHARA)

text.card: A nearby orange dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 76% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.7591 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 5,337 K.
